evidence.quote: Three Colts Tavern is a modern East End pub under the stewardship of Walthamstow’s Exale brewing.
We host Quiz nights, DJs, Drag bingo, Comedy nights, Live music and more
Think your funny enough for 5 minutes on stage?
This fortnightly roda jam brings together musicians to explore Choro: Brazil’s spirited, syncopated instrumental music
Join us for an Alt 80s night spun on vinyl

findings.value: Mostly nights rather than gigs: a fortnightly Brazilian choro jam on Mondays, a fortnightly Monday stand-up open spot, a fortnightly Wednesday pub quiz and a Thursday comedy night. Weekend DJ nights (a monthly party-classics night and an 80s vinyl night), plus monthly life-drawing classes.

evidence.quote: Join Long face comedy for a night of stand-up comedy every other Monday at the Glue Factory- Three Colts Tavern!
Join us for our fortnightly Colts Quiz
Deejay Merv Mayfield: The Melting Pot: Party Classics From Across The Genres
Classes are held monthly (various dates) from 6:30 PM to 8 PM
